build_vad_inputs: run make_vad_inputs.py to build VAD input list files from a LibriLight dataset directory
findAllSeqs_list_audio_files: use findAllSeqs to recursively list all audio files with speaker labels from a directory tree
get_lst_compute_durations: use get_lst to compute file durations in milliseconds for a list of audio file paths
save_lst_write_list_file: use save_lst to write a list of id, path, duration tuples to a text file
reorder_vad_reorganize_files: use reorder_vad to move VAD files alongside their corresponding WAV files and clean up temp files
